description: This Go source file defines functions related to processing markdown documents with front matter, including reading files, parsing front matter, translating content, and writing output files, primarily used for documentation internationalization.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: reads, parses, translates, and writes output.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the content into front matter and body sections based on YAML delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes the front matter data back into YAML format with added metadata.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific fields within the front matter, including title, summary, and read_when.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates individual text snippets with caching to optimize repeated translations.
